title: YouTube is reportedly preparing to settle social media addiction claims for $3 billion
description: YouTube is preparing to pay $3 billion to thousands of school districts to settle claims that its "addictive design" harmed kids, according to Bloomberg. Source

content.summary: YouTube is preparing to pay $3 billion to thousands of school districts to settle claims that its "addictive design" harmed kids, according to Bloomberg. Sources tell the publication that YouTube reached the agreement "in principle," and that the deal would also include new safeguards for teens. The settlement would allow Google to avoid a wave of lawsuits filed by US school districts that accuse YouTube, Meta, Snap, and TikTok of negatively impacting the mental health of teen users.
